sections.heading: Core Concepts: Probability as a number

questions.q: For the model $f(x) = 4x + 6$ in probability as a number, evaluate $f(2)$.
Find the positive solutions to the quadratic equation $x^2 - 4x + 3 = 0$.
A data set recorded for probability as a number consists of the four values $\{13, 17, 21, 27\}$. What is the arithmetic mean?
questions.answer: The sum is $13 + 17 + 21 + 27 = 78$, and dividing by $4$ gives $19.5$.
